items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 168:1
items.html: At the time of the second restriction, when the concluding Malchut ascended to the Bina of the body of the Partzuf of the TNHY of AK and of the Partzuf of the points of SAG, and the two lower thirds of the Tifferet and the NHYM went out below the concluding Malchut into the empty void, they then became the aspect of the place of BYA. For the two lower thirds of the Tifferet became the place of Beriah, and the NHY the place of Yetzirah, and the Malchut the place of Assiyah. (Item 8).
